note: These 3 house scripts have scriptAccess=closed_no_auth in the pine-facade list. The /get/<id>/<ver> SOURCE endpoint returns HTTP 401 {code:401, message:'User is not allowed to see source code of pine'} for ALL unauthenticated users (and the source is protected/closed regardless of login). Only obfuscated bytecode is available via /translate/ (HTTP 200). Readable Pine source is NOT retrievable via public HTTP. Recorded here for completeness; intentionally NOT counted in manifest.json. The daily updater fetches only manifest.json entries, so it will not churn on these.
